resources.string: Install a copy of the app under a name you choose
Other apps then see your copy, not locationjoystick
Allow this app to install apps, then tap Start again.
Building your copy. This takes a moment.
Confirm the install in the system screen.

Your copy is installed. It is a separate app with its own favorites and routes. Move them with Backup & Transfer. In Developer options, pick the copy as the mock location app. You can uninstall this app after you export your data.

Privacy Mode only hides the name of this app from other apps. The copy is a separate app with its own data. You must pick the copy as the mock location app in Developer options yourself. Apps that read the mock location setting can still see it.
